top.hero-open: Open today 10 am to 9:30 pm, all seven days
top.h1: New phone, old phone exchange, repair in 2 hours.
top.p: Every brand sold in India, with GST bill and brand warranty. Card EMI and finance at the counter. Screen and battery changed while you wait. Chargers, covers, earphones and a shelf of small home appliances.

photo.alt: Shop owner smiling at the counter in front of a wall of phone displays

top.span: 5G phone, 6 GB + 128 GB, with bill and warranty

phones.h2: Tell us your budget. We show you three phones, not thirty.
phones.p: Pick a budget. Example prices for the kind of phone it buys in 2026; exact models and prices change every month, so message us for today’s list.
phones.panel-intro: Big battery, big screen, good for calls, WhatsApp and videos. We set it up in Bengali if you want, with large font and your contacts moved across.
phones.h3: Basic 4G phone<small>6.5 inch screen, two days of battery</small>
phones.h32: Entry 5G phone<small>The one in the orange tag above</small>
phones.h33: Keypad phone<small>For the shop counter or a second number</small>
phones.panel-intro2: The shelf that sells most. Fast charging, a good camera in daylight, and enough storage for two years of photos.
phones.h34: 5G all-rounder<small>Sharp screen, 33 W charger in the box</small>
phones.panel-intro3: Bright 120 Hz AMOLED screens, better low-light cameras, smooth games. Most come with 67 W or faster charging.
phones.h39: Last year’s flagship<small>Top chip from last year at a lower price</small>
phones.panel-intro4: The top phones from Apple, Samsung and others. Sealed box, same price as the brand store, and we transfer your data before you leave.
phones.h310: Current flagship, base model<small>Five years of software updates</small>
phones.h311: Current flagship, Pro<small>Bigger screen, periscope zoom</small>

repairs.h2: Screen or battery changed in 2 hours.
repairs.p: We check the phone in front of you and tell you the price before we open it. If we cannot fix it, you pay nothing. Price depends on the model; these are the usual ranges.
repairs.rep-note: Your data stays on the phone. We never ask for your passwords; you open the phone yourself when we test it.

photo.alt: Technician under a lamp opening a phone at the repair bench

repairs.p2: Send a photo of the damage and the phone model. We reply with the price and the time it will take, so you come once.
repairs.span: 3 months’ warranty on every repair, on the part and the work.

items.td: Screen replacement <small>Original or best compatible, your choice</small>
Battery replacement <small>New battery, health shown on screen before you leave</small>
Speaker or mic <small>Low sound, no sound</small>
Water damage <small>Cleaning and check first, then we quote</small>
Software, data transfer, reset <small>Hanging phone, forgotten pattern, moving to a new phone</small>

emi.h2: Pay monthly, or trade in the phone you have.

photo.alt: A customer's hands scrolling through apps on a new phone

emi.p: 3, 6, 9 or 12 months on most bank cards. No-cost EMI on phones above ₹10,000 when the brand runs an offer, which is most months. Takes about five minutes at the counter.

photo2.alt: Phone camera pointed at festival lights on a Kolkata street at night

emi.p2: Bajaj, HDB and others. Approval on the spot in most cases, and you walk out with the phone the same day.

photo3.alt: Phones standing on display tables with a wall of covers behind

emi.p3: Bring your old phone. We check it in ten minutes and give you a fixed price off the new one.
emi.zig-ex: Example: a two-year-old ₹15,000 phone in good condition usually fetches ₹3,500 to ₹6,000 off the new phone. Flagships fetch more.

items.span: We swipe the card once; the bank splits it into EMIs within a week.
Processing fee, if any, is shown to you before you sign.
Bring: Aadhaar, PAN, a cancelled cheque or bank passbook, and the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar for the OTP.
Down payment: usually 10 to 20 percent of the price. The rest in 6 to 12 EMIs.
Salaried or self-employed both work. No hidden charges; the total you will pay is shown before you sign.
What we check: screen (cracks, dead spots), battery health, camera, charging, speaker, and whether it switches on and opens with your pattern.
What raises the value: original box and charger, no scratches on the screen, battery above 80 percent, a phone less than three years old.
What lowers it: cracked screen, swollen battery, water damage, a locked account that is not signed out.
Your data: we help you back up and sign out, then wipe the phone in front of you.

accessories.h2: Covers, chargers and earphones, fitted at the counter.
accessories.p: We put the tempered glass on for you, free, without bubbles. Chargers are branded and tested in front of you before billing. Try earphones before you pay.

photo.alt: A busy street stall selling phone covers and accessories

accessories.li: Back cover, silicone or clear ₹99 to 399
accessories.li6: Branded charger, 20 W to 67 W ₹399 to 1,499
accessories.acc-note: Covers for older models come in two days on order. If a tempered glass cracks within a month we replace it for half price.

appliances.h2: The upstairs shelf: things the house needs this week.
appliances.p: Not a showroom, just the small things people kept asking us for. Branded, with warranty card, and the same EMI as phones for anything above ₹3,000.

warranty.h2: What you get with every sale.

items.p: Printed and sent on WhatsApp. You need it for the brand warranty and for insurance claims.
Sealed box, IMEI matched to the bill. For a claim we send the phone to the brand service centre for you.
On the part and the work. Same fault again, we fix it free. Physical damage and water are not covered.
Dead on arrival, wrong colour, or a fault in the first week: come back with the box and we sort it out with the brand.

story.h2: One counter at Behala Chowrasta since 2012.
story.p: Pradip Ghosh opened this shop with four phones and a recharge counter. Today it is two floors: phones and accessories on the ground floor, a repair bench and small appliances upstairs. Four of us work here, and the owner is at the counter every day.
story.p2: We sell what we can stand behind. Every phone comes with a GST bill in your name, the sealed box, and the brand warranty. If something is wrong in the first seven days, bring it back and we deal with the brand for you. On any day there are forty or more phones in stock to pick up and try.

photo.alt: A young man at the upstairs counter trying a Bluetooth speaker

faq.h2: Things people ask at the counter.

items.h3: Is the price the same as online?
items.p: Usually within a few hundred rupees, and often the same during bank offers. You get the phone today, a bill in your name, and a shop to walk into if something goes wrong.

items.h3: Do you use original parts for repair?
items.p: We offer both: original parts where the brand supplies them, and good compatible parts that cost less. We tell you which is which and the price of each before we start.

items.h3: Can I wait while the phone is repaired?
items.p: Yes. Screen and battery take one to two hours. Sit downstairs, or leave it and we message you when it is ready.

items.h3: What do I bring for finance?
items.p: Aadhaar, PAN, a bank passbook or cancelled cheque, and the mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP. Salaried or self-employed both work.

items.h3: Do you buy old phones without an exchange?
items.p: Yes, for cash, but the price is lower than exchange value. Bring the box and bill if you have them.

items.h3: Do you do recharges and SIM cards?
items.p: Yes. All networks, prepaid and postpaid, and new SIMs with Aadhaar verification at the counter.
My phone screen broke on a Sunday evening. They changed it in an hour and a half and showed me the old one. Still working fine after six months.
Bought my mother a phone on EMI with just Aadhaar and PAN. They set it up in Bengali, put her contacts in and added the big font. She calls me herself now.
